name: plain-docker-run-is-not-gated-by-escape-rules
note: GUARD: the escape gates target only --privileged and host/socket mounts. `docker run myimg` surfaces no docker.run.* escape capability, so neither escape gate fires. With no rule allowing a bare docker run it fails closed to gommage; the point is that it does NOT become an ask_picto for docker.run.privileged or docker.run.hostmount.
